prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: user-facing Five Elements model — Wood element
Input images: Image 1 is the clay material, lighting, softness, camera, and finish reference only; do not include the oracle character
Primary request: create a cute symbolic Wood-element sculpture: one small rounded young tree growing from a softly twisted root base, with five plump clay leaves and one tiny new sprout, communicating growth and renewal at a glance
Style/medium: premium handmade matte 3D polymer-clay model; rounded collectible designer-toy proportions; subtle fingerprints and sculpting irregularities; same softness and polish as Image 1
Composition/framing: one centered isolated object, front three-quarter view, compact clear silhouette, generous equal padding, no cropping
Lighting/mood: bright diffused studio daylight from upper left, soft neutral-lavender bounce, calm and hopeful
Color palette: fresh jade green and soft sage leaves, muted warm-brown root, one tiny pale-lilac accent bud; green remains the dominant meaningful element color
Scene/backdrop: perfectly uniform flat chroma-key magenta (#FF00FF), edge to edge, for clean post-production cutout
Constraints: no character, no face, no eyes, no text, no Chinese characters, no symbols, no pot, no scenery, no frame, no watermark, no cast shadow, no background texture or reflection; exactly one tree sculpture
Avoid: realistic bark, flat icon, glossy plastic, bonsai pot, forest scene, extra objects, green-screen background
